key_insight: Laser power mainly governs penetration and keyhole formation, while welding speed and current tune molten-pool flow, weld width, and arc stability in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel.
engineering_relevance: These results help optimize hybrid welding settings for low-expansion Invar components by balancing bead geometry, fluid dynamics, and arc behavior.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool fluid flow and morphology evolution
High-speed photography to observe arc characteristics during welding
Parameter sweep across laser power, welding speed, and welding current
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent parameter-dependent trends in penetration depth, weld width, molten-pool convection, and arc deflection/stability across the tested process windows.
watch_item: The conclusions are based on a limited parameter range, so transfer to other joint geometries, thicknesses, or shielding conditions may require revalidation.
paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
